prompt.main: Create a cinematic 60-second product demo for a modern CRM platform that transforms chaotic sales processes into streamlined deal-closing machines. Open with a frustrated sales rep drowning in spreadsheets and missed follow-ups across 8 different tools, losing deals to competitors. Transition to discovering the CRM solution, showing elegant automation, intelligent deal prioritization, and team collaboration features. Close with the same rep confidently closing deals, hitting quotas, and celebrating with their team. Use a Problem-Reaction-Solution narrative structure with dramatic lighting shifts from dark/chaotic to bright/organized. Include smooth UI animations, professional color grading, and upbeat background music that builds energy.
prompt.opening: Open on a modern office at 7 PM. A sales representative, backlit by multiple monitors, frantically switches between tabs: Excel spreadsheets with hundreds of leads, Gmail with 247 unread messages, Slack notifications pinging constantly, a calendar full of conflicting meetings. They're typing furiously, looking stressed. A notification pops up: 'Meeting with Johnson Corp in 5 minutes' but they can't find the client notes. Quick cuts show: A lead going cold, a competitor's email in the client's inbox, a missed follow-up reminder. Close-up on the rep's frustrated face. Text overlay: 'Your sales team is drowning.' Dark, desaturated color grading with harsh fluorescent lighting.
prompt.middle:
REACTION (8 seconds): Cut to a dashboard showing metrics trending down: 'Deals Lost: +43%', 'Response Time: 2.3 days', 'Rep Productivity: -28%'. The sales manager looks at quarterly projections falling short. Quick montage: A valuable client choosing a competitor, a team meeting with tension, revenue goals being missed. Voiceover: 'Every lost deal isn't just money—it's momentum.' Music becomes more urgent.

SOLUTION (37 seconds): Screen goes black. A single notification sound. The rep's phone lights up: 'Try [CRM Name]'. Fade to bright, modern office—same rep, but now calm and confident. They open a clean, intuitive CRM dashboard. 

Show key features in action:
1. AI Lead Scoring (5s): Leads automatically ranked by conversion probability, high-value prospects highlighted in gold
2. Automated Follow-ups (5s): Emails and tasks auto-generated based on deal stage, sent at optimal times
3. 360° Client View (5s): All communications, documents, and history in one unified timeline
4. Real-time Collaboration (5s): Team members adding notes, manager approving discounts, all in-platform
5. Smart Reminders (4s): Context-aware notifications: 'Johnson Corp decision maker just opened your proposal'
6. Pipeline Visualization (5s): Drag-and-drop deal stages, automatic revenue forecasting
7. Mobile Access (4s): Rep closing a deal from their phone while commuting

Show metrics improving in real-time: Response time down to 4 hours, deals closing 35% faster, team hitting 127% of quota.
prompt.closing: Return to the same office, but transformed. Natural lighting, organized workspace, confident rep. They close a major deal on a video call, shake hands virtually. Team celebrates. Dashboard shows: 'Monthly Target: Exceeded', 'Team Performance: Record High'. The rep leaves office at 5 PM, smiling. Final shot: Clean CRM dashboard with all deals moving right. Text overlay: 'Stop drowning. Start closing.' Logo appears with CTA: 'Start Your 14-Day Free Trial'. Uplifting, victorious music.
visualGuidelines: Use color grading to show transformation: Desaturated cool tones (problem) → Vibrant warm tones (solution)
Opening: Chaotic quick cuts, handheld camera feel, cluttered frame composition
Solution: Smooth Steadicam movements, organized compositions, clean negative space
UI animations should be smooth, 60fps, with subtle micro-interactions
Show real data and realistic scenarios, not abstract concepts
Use depth of field to focus attention: Blurred background during problem, sharp clarity during solution
Include diverse team members to show inclusivity
Lighting: Harsh overhead fluorescents (problem) → Soft natural window light (solution)
Typography: Bold, modern sans-serif for on-screen text, high contrast
Transition at 'Solution' moment: Use a satisfying screen swipe or fade through white

storyboard.visual: Overhead shot of cluttered desk: laptop with 15+ browser tabs, phone buzzing with notifications, printed spreadsheets with handwritten notes, cold coffee. Sales rep's hands frantically moving between keyboard and mouse. Camera slowly pushes in.
storyboard.voiceover: Meet Sarah. She's an amazing sales rep. But her tools are killing her.

storyboard.onScreen: Excel · Gmail · Slack · Calendly · DocuSign · LinkedIn · Zoom · HubSpot

storyboard.visual: Close-up: Notification popup 'Meeting with Johnson Corp in 5 min'. Sarah's eyes widen. She frantically searches through folders. Can't find the notes. Clock ticking.
storyboard.voiceover: Where are the client notes? What did we discuss last time?
storyboard.onScreen: Johnson Corp · $180K Deal · Stage: Final Decision

storyboard.visual: Dashboard on sales manager's screen: Red arrows pointing down. 'Deals Lost This Quarter: +43%', 'Avg Response Time: 2.3 days', 'Team Productivity: -28%'. Manager's hand runs through hair in frustration.

storyboard.visual: Montage of consequences: Email from prospect 'Going with another vendor', team meeting with tense faces, revenue forecast chart declining, Sarah staying late again (now 9:15 PM).
storyboard.voiceover: Lost deals. Missed quotas. Burned-out reps.
storyboard.music: Silence with just ambient office sounds

storyboard.visual: Black screen. Pause. Single notification sound. Phone screen lights up in darkness showing: 'Your team is trying [CRM Name]'
storyboard.voiceover: [Silence]

storyboard.visual: Same office, same desk, but morning light streaming through windows. Clean workspace. Sarah arrives at 9 AM, relaxed, coffee in hand. Opens laptop to beautiful, minimal CRM dashboard.

storyboard.visual: Close-up of CRM dashboard: AI lead scoring in action. Leads automatically organized by priority. High-value prospects highlighted in gold with confidence scores (94%, 87%, 91%). AI insights: 'Johnson Corp shows high intent - opened proposal 3x, visited pricing page.'
storyboard.voiceover: AI tells you exactly who to focus on, and when.

storyboard.visual: Automated follow-up system: Watch as emails compose themselves based on deal stage. 'Day 3 after demo: Check-in email' auto-generates with personalized content, sends at optimal time (10:23 AM based on recipient's open patterns). Sarah just reviews and clicks approve.

storyboard.visual: 360° client view: Unified timeline showing all interactions. Scroll through: initial contact email, demo call recording, proposal sent, questions asked, pricing discussed, decision makers identified, competitor mentions noted. Everything in context, chronological, searchable.
storyboard.voiceover: Every conversation, every document, every insight—in one place.

storyboard.visual: Real-time collaboration: Split screen showing Sarah's view and manager's view of same deal. Sarah adds note: 'Client requesting custom terms'. Manager instantly sees it, approves discount, adds encouragement: 'Great work on this one!'. Deal updates in real-time for both.
storyboard.voiceover: Your team moves as one. No delays, no confusion.

storyboard.visual: Smart notification appears: 'Johnson Corp CFO just opened your proposal. View time: 8 minutes. Focus area: ROI section.' Sarah immediately sends a perfectly-timed follow-up email addressing ROI. Client responds within 10 minutes.
storyboard.voiceover: Know exactly when prospects engage, and what they care about.
storyboard.music: Alert sound effect on notification, music swells

storyboard.visual: Pipeline board: Visual drag-and-drop kanban of deals. Watch deals automatically move: 'Demo Scheduled' → 'Proposal Sent' → 'Negotiation' → 'Closed Won'. Revenue forecast updates in real-time at top: '$1.2M projected this month'. Probability scores adjust automatically.

storyboard.visual: Sarah on morning commute (train/car). Phone shows mobile CRM app. Push notification: 'Johnson Corp ready to sign'. She opens mobile app, reviews contract, adds final note, gets manager approval, sends to client. Deal status updates to 'Contract Sent'. All from her phone.

storyboard.visual: Back at desk, Sarah on video call with Johnson Corp. Client smiles, nods, signs digital contract on screen. Confetti animation in CRM. Deal moves to 'Closed Won' - $180K. Team Slack channel celebrates with emojis. Manager gives thumbs up from across office.

storyboard.visual: Dashboard analytics showing transformation: 'Response Time: 4 hours' (down from 2.3 days), 'Deals Closed: +61%', 'Team Quota: 127%', 'Revenue: $1.4M' (above target). Graphs trending sharply upward. Green checkmarks everywhere.

storyboard.visual: Final hero shot of CRM dashboard: Clean design, all deals organized, AI insights glowing, team collaboration active, pipeline healthy. Camera slowly pulls back to reveal full screen. Dashboard reflects in Sarah's satisfied smile.
storyboard.voiceover: This is sales, simplified.

variations: 30-second version: Focus only on #1 pain point (missed follow-ups) and #1 solution (automation)
90-second version: Add customer testimonial in middle section, show ROI calculator, include integration showcase
Vertical (9:16) version: Optimize for Instagram/TikTok with text overlays carrying more narrative weight
Industry-specific: Create versions for Real Estate CRM, Insurance CRM, Manufacturing CRM with tailored pain points
Founder-focused: Open with founder's story of building the company after experiencing these exact problems

technicalSpecs.colorGrading: Teal and orange for problem sections, warm naturalistic for solution sections, high contrast throughout
